missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Библиотека' is a feminine noun in the nominative, the subject of 'работает'. 'Наша' agrees with it, and 'до восьми' gives the closing time.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Библиотеку' is the accusative direct object of 'посещаю', with the feminine ending shifting to -у. 'Каждый день' adds frequency.

missions.phrase: Я иду в библиотеку за книгой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В библиотеку' uses the accusative after 'в' to show motion toward a place. 'За книгой' explains the purpose of the trip.

missions.phrase: Я весь день сижу в библиотеке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В библиотеке' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to show static location. 'Весь день' adds duration to the studying scene.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Из библиотеки' uses the genitive after 'из' to show motion out of a place. 'Поздно' tells when, completing a natural motion phrase.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'К библиотеке' uses the dative after 'к' to show approach toward a place. 'Вечером' is an instrumental adverb of time.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'перед'. 'Библиотекой' is the instrumental form required by 'перед', showing position in front. 'Памятник' is the nominative subject of 'стоит'.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'много'. 'Библиотек' is the genitive plural with a zero ending, required by 'много'. 'Старых' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Библиотеки' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'открылись', which agrees in the plural. 'Новые' agrees, and 'в районе' locates them.
Strategic focus: Nominative with genitive modifier. 'Библиотека' is the nominative predicate noun, 'самая большая' is the superlative phrase, and 'города' is a genitive modifier showing belonging.
